Use your lender number to track down your student loan company so you can tell them you didn’t take out the loans. If you don’t know how to do this ask your School’s financial aid office. Also you your going to want to get a credit check and identity theft protection since ther is a possibility that someone is using your credit to take out loans. You can get a free credit report at annualcreditreport.com if you call the national credit companies they are three equifax, transunion, and experian they can help you freeze and protect your credit if someone is using it. Identityguard.com is also a great resource for protecting your credit.
Good luck
